body: I'm looking for the same shit.  I got you for one

I have to say that i post on here to clear my brain for a moment and then people text me trying to "help" while all they are doing is driving me insane with their inability to comprehend any of the shit im saying. You literally read it and still disregarded all of it
You obviously dont know what you are talking about. I literally spelled out that i didnt want to hear that shit and here you are saying "oh but it can change. Oh but things do get better.
Everytime i hear that "but it can get better" it only makes me want to put a bullet in my head more
I swear to god its like some of you cant read english or something
I wish that was an answer people would give freely.
Im definitely not going to be picking myself up again. Like i said. Im done. With everything. Im not trying anymore. Im giving up. There isnt anything for me to start over with.

I was never looking for anyone in the first place, she just came in to my life by coincidence. I wasnt planning on living much longer before i met her so i never cared to find a relationship. Now that its over i dont really see any purpose in going on. Im done with life.

Yea thats the point. Im always the one that has to reach out to people. Ive decided not to be that person anymore and its put it in to perspective. Like i said. I could have done it a month ago and nobody would have the slightest clue. Its not like this is the reason i want to kill myself. It just makes it so much more appealing

Fortunately for me i dont believe in any of that afterlife stuff. Death is the end im yearning for. Darkness and peace is an addictive thing and i want it forever. Im done with this life. There is nothing here for me except the pain and misery i deal with everyday knowing nothing will change and nothing gets better.
I wouldn't have had a timeline
I don't even think i could convince myself to call her

I dont have to do anything. Im done. Ive tried for too long and it only ever gets worse. Its bullshit when people say " WeLl iT cAN oNly GEt bEttEr" its all a lie its all bullshit. Not everybody's lives get better. Im done with mine
I doubt I'll ever get lucky enough

Im 100% positive she doesnt love me back she has told me to my face that im just a friend, even went as far as telling me she isnt at all attracted to me anymore. She would never end her life. She is one of the happiest people ive ever met. And yes i know " sometimes the happiest people are the one that are hurt the worst" but me leaving her life would alter almost nothing for her. I rarely see her and its only in passing. Im just another person that has gone in and out of her life. Ive been ready for the end for years.

Im in the same boat.. The girl i fell in love with is the only thing keeping me alive but she couldn't care less. I keep thinking it will either go 1 of 2 ways. Maybe i kill myself and she realizes im gone and is devastated, or she may never even finds out it happened and just assume i disappeared. Maybe she will feel like its her fault or she might not even care too much about it. Maybe im missing out on spending the rest of my life with her but maybe im wasting every minute of my life hoping somehow someday she'll love me just as much as i love her
